title: Ordinary normalization of coefficient-first vector integration
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N>0 annihilate A, S a Noetherian scheme with N invertible, and F a locally free S-module of rank d. Use W, the compact-support adjunction, and the canonical coefficient-first projection of [def-pur-vector-integration-adjunction-arrows]. Let K be any ordinary derived A-module object on S, and pe an isomorphism from ordinary compact support of pi^*K tensor W to K tensor ordinary compact support of W whose inverse is that actual projection. Let ae be pe.hom followed by 1 tensor the normalized ordinary vector integration and the ordinary finite-unit right unitor [def-pur-finite-site-tensor-projection]. Then there exists the prescribed normalized natural purity transformation gamma of [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization] such that the adjunction transpose of ae equals the canonical signed symmetry pi^*K tensor W to W tensor pi^*K followed by gamma.app K. No constructibility restriction is added; existence of pe is the stated assumption.

proof.text: The coefficient-first projection is the right-coefficient projection conjugated by the two canonical signed symmetries. Precompose the desired integration identity by pe.inv. Cancel pe, combine the two source symmetries using involutivity, and use the normalization of m. Naturality moves the trace across symmetry; the braiding unit law converts the left unitor into the right unitor. Thus ae is compact support of the source symmetry followed by m. Generic coefficient-category helpers prove the symmetry square and unit identity before specializing to module sheaves; the existing Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso_inv identifies the canonical finite-unit comparison with the identity.

theorem vectorTensorOrdinaryNormalization
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (d : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A S)
    (pe : (Etale.vectorBundlePurityLower A S d F).obj
        (Etale.vectorBundlePurityTwistedPullback A N hA S d F K) ≅
      ((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj K).obj
        (Etale.vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F))
    (hpe : pe.inv = Etale.vectorBundlePurityProjectionMap A N hA S d F K) :
    letI : IsAffineHom (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) :=
      (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).1
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) :=
      (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).2.1
    ∃ γ : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.VectorPurityGamma A N hA S d F,
      WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.VectorPurityGammaNormalized
        A N hN hA S hS d F γ ∧
      HEq ((Etale.vectorBundlePurityAdjunction A S d F).homEquiv _ K
        (ordinaryTensorIntegrate A S K (Etale.vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d F)
          _ pe (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA S hS d F)))
        ((((Etale.derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
          (VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme S d F)).hom.app
            ((Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F)).obj K)).app
              (Etale.vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d F)) ≫ γ.app K)
